editorial:
Imagine you are having the worst day of your life. You are dressed in your best suit, headed to a job interview that could change everything, and you are terrified of being late. But while you are stressing out and practicing your apology, the world around you is literally falling apart. People are screaming, the city is being emptied, and total chaos is breaking out in the streets. You get to follow this one man who is so focused on his goal that he barely notices the disaster happening right in front of him. It creates a really weird and tense feeling where the small stress of a job interview clashes with a giant catastrophe.

What really makes this work is the acting and the way the tension builds up. The pacing is tight, and you will find yourself wondering why the main character is so oblivious to the danger. It is a short but punchy story that shows how people can get tunnel vision when they are scared. It is a great pick for a quick movie night if you like stories that feel like a fever dream.
endingExplained: At the very end, the man finally reaches the office for his interview, completely ignoring the ruins of the city. He walks into the room and says his line, sorry I am late, only to realize that there is no one left to interview him. The twist is that the world has ended while he was walking. He wins his battle against the clock, but it does not matter because society has completely collapsed.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark humor and weird stories about human nature.
